headline: Jeffrey M. Rubin
: Arbitrator, Mediator, Expert Witness & Consultant
hero.subheadline: Arbitraton (ARIAS-US, ARIAS-UK, FINRA, NFA), Mediaton (ARIAS-US), Expert Witness & Consulting

about.content: Mr. Rubin has a unique combination of experience as a senior corporate executive managing large exposure reinsurance and insurance claims and broad experience as outside counsel litigating a wide variety of significant commercial cases. For eighteen years, Mr. Rubin served as Director of Global Claims at Odyssey, overseeing the handling of the most significant insurance and reinsurance claims within the group. Before joining Odyssey, Mr. Rubin was General Counsel, Director of Litigation, and Reinsurance Workout Specialist at The Resolution Group and its successor RiverStone Resources (“TRG”). During his tenure at TRG, Mr. Rubin successfully managed the exposure of Sphere Drake, Ltd. to the workers compensation reinsurance carve out spiral which resulted in the seminal decision of the London Commercial Court in Sphere Drake Insurance Ltd. and Euro International Underwriting, Stirling Cooke Brown, et al. Mr. Rubin also oversaw the strategy of all declaratory judgment actions and coverage litigation and settled high exposure claims. Before moving to the corporate side, Mr. Rubin practiced law in Chicago for sixteen years, twelve of which were at the firm of Phelan, Pope & John, Ltd., where he became a partner. As part of his law practice Mr. Rubin handled commercial cases in a wide variety of substantive areas including real estate, securities, commodities, employment, partnership severance, banking, construction, products liability, civil rights, and white-collar crime. Mr. Rubin has also been a leader in the legal community having served as Chairman of ARIAS-US, Member of the Board of Managers of the Chicago Bar Association, and Chairman of the Judicial Evaluation Committee of the Chicago Bar Association.

list.name: Arbitration
list.desc: Mr. Rubin has served as an arbitrator, umpire, and outside counsel in arbitrations involving reinsurance, insurance, commercial transactions, securities, and commodities. As Director of Global Claims and in-house counsel Mr. Rubin has managed approximately 300 arbitration proceedings in the US and the UK.

list.name: Mediation
list.desc: Mr. Rubin has settled many substantial cases and claims, and participated in numerous mediations, as company representative, in house counsel, and outside counsel. As a senior company executive who was responsible for litigation and arbitration of disputes and claims, Mr. Rubin understands how to assess the likelihood of success, and the significant expenses associated with dispute resolution.

list.name: Expert Witness
list.desc: With 27 years of experience in reinsurance and insurance, Mr. Rubin has deep industry knowledge with particular expertise with respect to claims handling, reinsurance cessions, aggregation of claims, and bad faith. As Director of Global Claims at Odyssey for eighteen years, Mr. Rubin was responsible for overseeing the handling of policy limit demands and allegations of bad faith with respect to claims made on insurance policies issued by Hudson Insurance Company and the Newline Syndicate. Based on his extensive industry experience, Mr. Rubin is well qualified to testify as an expert witness with respect to insurance and reinsurance claims handling issues and bad faith.

list.name: Consulting
list.desc: Mr. Rubin has successfully managed “bet the company” and high stakes cases in litigation and arbitration while working on the corporate side. In doing so, he drew upon his sixteen years of experience as outside counsel, where he litigated high profile cases and handled complex litigation in Chicago and throughout the US. Mr. Rubin may be available for the right type of case, and in the right type of circumstances, to provide case management advice or services or to provide a second opinion regarding the exposure, litigation costs, and management strategy for successful resolution of the case.
